name: Gatehouse Goods

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you help move goods between Stormwind shopkeepers and the neighboring gatehouse through discreet deliveries at Trias' Cheese.
As a rogue, you know how to move quietly around Trias' Cheese and notice details like doors that open inward.

faq.answer: Gatehouse Goods is a Stormwind delivery between Trias' Cheese and the neighboring gatehouse. A courier carries the shipment upstairs and leaves it outside the gatehouse stockroom door.
The shipment goes up the stairs inside Trias' Cheese. Though the shop is a separate business, its building shares a floor with the gatehouse, and the crate is left outside the stockroom.
faq.q: Where is the shipment supposed to be delivered?

faq.answer: The courier is told to leave the crate outside the stockroom. Gatehouse guards watch for deliveries and arrange for someone to carry them in when returning to their posts.
faq.q: Why is the crate left outside the door instead of brought inside?

faq.answer: The stockroom door opens inward, so goods left outside will not block the doorway or hinder people inside.
faq.q: Why does the stockroom door open inward?

aliases: is trias cheese part of gatehouse
faq.answer: No. Trias' Cheese is a separate business with its own inventory, though it shares a floor with the gatehouse.
faq.q: Is Trias' Cheese affiliated with the gatehouse?

faq.answer: Local operators arrange the delivery and expect professional respect and discretion. After a successful drop-off that leaves the threshold clear, they acknowledge reliable couriers.
faq.q: Who oversees the delivery of the goods?

sections.body: Couriers carry a gatehouse shipment up the stairs inside Trias' Cheese. The cheese shop is a separate business with its own inventory, yet its building shares a floor with the neighboring gatehouse. From the upper landing, couriers can move supplies between the two quarters without using the front avenues.
sections.title: Shared Quarters and Shared Floors

sections.body: The crate is left outside the stockroom door rather than carried inside. Gatehouse guards watch for deliveries and arrange for someone to collect each package when returning to their posts. The door opens inward, so a crate outside will not block the entry or hinder anyone inside.
sections.title: A Practical Drop-off

summary: In Stormwind, Gatehouse Goods moves from Trias' Cheese to the neighboring gatehouse. The route takes the shipment up the shop's stairs to a landing on the same floor, where guards can collect it outside the stockroom. Shared quarters link the city's shops and defenses.
